reviews.review: If your racist and hate orks you will love this game
The campaign is fun and the multiplayer is dead. So, the question is "WILL YOU BE JOINING US, BROTHER?"

Good for an older shooter / hack 'n slash action game, although a bit short. Reminds me a bit of the newer doom actually with similar weapons and melee attacks to regain health, although doom does it better. I Finished the game in 8 hours and that was with taking things slow and dying a bit. Despite being short, it feels like it drags on a little, but ends up not overstaying its welcome. There was one disappointing thing: the bossfight at the end is a long button mashing QTE, when I had hoped for a more interesting bossfight.

There is multiplayer with versus and co-op modes, but when I checked it out no one was playing. Could be fun with friends or a gamer group.

As someone not really that familiar with warhammer I thought it was an interesting setting, although I'm sure I missed many of the details or references to the lore. It seems like it might be a good starting point for someone who wants to check out the warhammer universe, but this also means it could be a bit shallow for old fans. To me this game is the closest thing to what Starcraft Ghosts could have been (it was supposed to be a 3rd person action shooter set in the Starcraft universe, but was never finished). So just running around and shooting stuff as a beefy space marine, whether its Starcraft or Warhammer, definitely warms the cockles of my cold heart.

Conclusion: I wouldn't get it at full 20$ price, considering the dead multiplayer, but can definitely recommend it on sale below 10$ for the decent campaign to anyone who likes games like the new doom or is interested in warhammer.

It's 2021, ten years after release and this is still the only good 40K universe FPS/TPS that ever happened, and it supports multiplayer!

And there's Dreadnought! 

The only thing that's missing is being able to play as an Imperial Guardsman.
